lede: (gold and rhodium worn together, one body part per card; every letter of the headline is warm on its left half and cool on its right.)
idea: GIVA owns the word silver and every gold brand owns gold; nobody sells the pair. Naira has both metals across the catalogue and one piece — the Heartbead — that is both at once, so the set opens with it and then pairs a gold piece with a rhodium piece on a hand, a neck, an ear, and finally the same dome ring cast in each metal. Every card prices the pair, which is the basket the research says the brand needs.
type: TWO METALS. in Velista, auto-fitted to the column, each glyph filled with a hard-stopped gradient — deep gold to the left of centre, steel to the right — so the type performs the idea before the copy does. Two columns beneath, ruled in the metal's own colour, list the gold piece and the silver piece with the listing's figures; the foot totals the pair.
review: Pass 1: the split headline sat over the photo veil and read faint, the story headline clipped, and the neck plate showed the lips. Pass 2: metal gradients darkened, the headline sized to the column with a one-pixel ivory drop, the neck re-cut below the chin, the ear card's top strip set in ivory over the dark hair. The archive's dome-pair hand series was rejected because it rendered the Pavé Dome as granulation; the pair was generated fresh with each surface locked.
verdict: the dome pair — one design, cast twice — is the card that explains the whole set in a glance.

M1.title: One bracelet
M1.why: The Heartbead never had to choose: mirror steel spheres on the strand, gold on the toggle and the heart. The website's own wrist shot.
M1.check: mirror steel (not pearls), gold toggle and heart

M2.title: One hand
M2.why: Petite Pavé in gold on the index, Whisper Pavé in rhodium on the middle finger. Two rings, ₹1,798.
M2.check: 4 bands 2 pavé 2 plain with the crossing stone; 8mm round brilliant in a cushion halo

M3.title: One neck
M3.why: The silver Serpentine sits higher at 40cm, the gold Toggle lower at 50cm; the listing lengths do the layering.
M3.check: 2mm snake chain with 10mm cushion; 4mm paperclip with toggle at the front; face cropped out

M4.title: One ear
M4.why: Pearl Blossom in the lobe, the brushed gold huggie in the piercing above it. Brushed satin against polished rhodium is the point.
M4.check: pavé bow over a 9mm pearl; 12mm brushed huggie; no third earring

M5.title: One design
M5.why: The Granule Dome and the Pavé Dome are the same ring cast twice: smooth gold beads on one, faceted stones on the other, open backs on both. Four units of each, so the button routes to Rings.
M5.source: new generation 682fd5fb (archive #2503 series rejected: pavé rendered as beads)
M5.check: pavé stones on the rhodium dome, granulation with no stones on the gold, open-back shanks
